headlines.text: Flash back to 2023, when the inaugural NJPW World TV Title was crowned as Zack Sabre Jr. vs. Action Andretti went to war, appearing on Rampage, rated 7.50 ? a strong outing. Sabre showed off his trademark grappling, countering a springboard attempt into a Rings of Saturn to make Andretti tap and retain the NJPW World Television Championship.

On this day in 2023, Willow Nightingale vs. Emi Sakura etched their names into history in the first-ever NJPW STRONG Women's Title match, appearing on Rampage, rated 7.15 ? a well-paced, entertaining battle. Nightingale survived a hard-fought challenge from Emi Sakura, a wrestler she considers a mentor figure in the sport, eventually landing a sit-out powerbomb to retain her NJPW Strong Women's Championship.

Turning the clock back to 2023: Katsuyori Shibata vs. Lee Moriarty went to battle over the ROH Pure Title, appearing on Rampage, rated 7.08 ? a match that delivered. Championship gold always raises the stakes.
